loader_bug_disclosure.description: Phase 3 PI-FNO checkpoint saved state_dict with `fno.fno.*` prefix (SCFNOModel wrapping PaddedFNO(fno, pad_size=0)). The Phase 4A.0.F baseline script and Phase 4A.1 training script loaded into a single-wrapped SCFNOModel (`fno.*` prefix). Result: 40 checkpoint keys (`fno.fno.*`) were unexpected and never loaded; the FNO backbone stayed at Phase 2 `fno_best.pt` initialization. Phase 3 FNO weights differ from Phase 2 by up to 20% per key (max diff 0.203 on one weight, sum diff 2.49 over 40 keys). The bug was real and consequential.
